items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: And Paul Robeson, I bought some of his things, because of his sound.

ctx.x: Did you buy a lot of records at any time? I mean was that a thing that you...

No, that wasn't a thing. There was things that interested me, you know, 'cause when Bird came out with his things I bought some of his records and Norman Granz. I listened to them. And then I began to hear Mahalia Jackson. I bought some of her things because of the sound, you see. I'm very sound conscious. And Paul Robeson, I bought some of his things, because of his sound.
